when I run the gyrokinetic/creg/rt_gk_sheath_1x2v_p1.c regression test, the simulation crashes (meaning the
  simulation terminates because the time step becomes too small). Can you help me figure out what I did wrong in my
  new collisionless gyrokinetic solver (gk_collisionless_flux and dg_dg_updater_gyrokinetic)? Previously I had tested
  this new approach for periodic boundaries and found it to work fine, but now that I've adapted it for nonperiodic
  boundaries something is wrong for that case.
I'll start by looking at the current state of the changes and the relevant solver code.
